tweets.text: Distilling most of our expertise in kernel and inference engine optimization into an agent loop that powers our production. A 2-year project that we're finally able to share

I've always believed that intelligence should come from simple, general building blocks that learn their own abstractions directly from raw data; in other words, the bitter lesson. I think we're finally seeing a real step towards AI that can learn from all data.\

FlashAttention is widely used to accelerate Transformers, already making attention 4-8x faster, but has yet to take advantage of modern GPUs. We’re releasing FlashAttention-3: 1.5-2x faster on FP16, up to 740 TFLOPS on H100 (75% util), and FP8 gets close to 1.2 PFLOPS!\
